It started just any usual Tuesday when a routine visit led into discovery – something quite simple to find at that.

Certainly, I suppose one cannot say the ordinary doesn t carry the unexpected with ease and aplombs sometimes.
  
This peculiar Wednesday had all that familiar tiring shuffle about the daily schedule – the coffee at nine thirty-three just when a storm was breaking up on our usual morning run; meetings in endless loops with only brief windows between which we dashed into cubbies with half-packed meals or to my corner by that sunny, small, but well-styled window for those last ten or twenty pages, a habit picked out during the summer days
